patch_description: Replace the anchor-greedy attachment heuristic with an exact directed Steiner dynamic program for practical destination-set sizes. The planner evaluates every possible subset merge at every relay, then propagates those shared subtree costs backward over priced links. This finds the minimum-cost shared broadcast arborescence rather than committing early to locally cheap branches. A bounded fallback preserves scalability for unusually large receiver sets while retaining shared-trunk behavior.
